test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the Chief Minister of Tripura as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biplab Kumar Deb.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Biplab Kumar Deb is the Chief Minister of Tripura. 
 
• He took oath as the 10th Chief Minister of the state in March 2018. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• About Tripura: As of Sept 2022:

 
 
• ​Capital: Agartala
 
• Chief minister: Manik Saha
 
• Governor: Satyadev Narayan Arya
 
• Union territory: 1 November 1956
 
• Upgraded as State: 21 January 1972
 
• State Animal: Phayre's leaf monkey
 
• State Bird: Green imperial pigeon
